Branchr Pad: Phone Stand Bamboo USB Hub with Writing Pad

Branchr Pad: Phone stand Bamboo USB hub with Writing pad is a thoughtfully designed all-in-one desktop accessory that combines productivity, connectivity, and sustainability. Crafted for modern professionals, corporate offices, and co-working environments, Branchr Pad transforms your workspace into a clean, organized, and efficient setup while adding a natural, premium aesthetic.

Featuring a stylish bamboo design, this multifunctional desk essential blends natural aesthetics with modern utility. The smooth bamboo finish not only enhances visual appeal but also reflects an eco-Friendly approach, making Branchr Pad a perfect choice for brands that value sustainability and smart design.

Smart Connectivity with Integrated USB Hub

The built-in USB hub makes Branchr Pad: Phone stand Bamboo USB hub with Writing pad a powerful productivity companion. It includes 4 USB output ports—2 × USB-A and 2 × USB-C—allowing you to connect and charge multiple devices effortlessly. From smartphones and wireless earbuds to keyboards and smart accessories, everything stays powered and accessible.

With dual USB and Type-C input compatibility, Branchr Pad ensures seamless integration with laptops, desktops, and modern devices. This flexibility makes it suitable for evolving tech environments without the need for additional adapters or hubs.

Built-In Phone Stand for Seamless Workflows

The integrated mobile stand securely holds your phone at an optimal viewing angle, making it ideal for video calls, online meetings, content viewing, or quick notifications. Whether you’re working remotely or collaborating in an office, Branchr Pad keeps your phone visible and hands-free.

Writing Pad for Quick Notes & Daily Planning

One of the standout features of Branchr Pad: Phone stand Bamboo USB hub with Writing pad is the included writing pad with 120 sheets. It allows you to jot down quick notes, reminders, to-do lists, or meeting points without cluttering your desk with loose papers. This makes it an excellent tool for professionals who prefer handwritten notes alongside digital work.

The integrated pen holder further enhances desk organization by keeping your pen within easy reach, reducing distractions and maintaining a tidy workspace throughout the day.

Compact, Durable & Desk-Friendly Design

Designed with practicality in mind, features a compact and durable structure that fits comfortably on desks, workstations, reception counters, and co-working spaces. The solid bamboo construction ensures long-term durability while maintaining a lightweight, elegant profile. Its smooth edges and premium finish make it safe, comfortable, and visually appealing—perfect for executive desks, corporate gifting, and employee onboarding kits.

Ideal for Corporate Branding & Promotional Use

Phone stand Bamboo USB hub with Writing pad offers excellent branding space to showcase your company logo, tagline, or message. The natural bamboo surface provides high visibility and a premium feel, ensuring your brand stands out in daily use. This makes a highly effective corporate gift, promotional product, or branded office accessory that delivers long-term brand recall while offering genuine utility.

Key Features at a Glance

  • Stylish bamboo design blending natural aesthetics with modern utility
  • 4 USB output ports: 2 × USB-A and 2 × USB-C
  • Dual USB and Type-C input compatibility
  • Built-in mobile stand for calls and video meetings
  • Writing pad with 120 sheets for notes and reminders
  • Integrated pen holder for organized workspaces
  • Compact and durable structure ideal for desks and co-working spaces
  • Smooth bamboo finish for a premium, eco-conscious look
  • Large branding area for company logo and identity

If you are looking for a modern desk accessory that combines charging, organization, note-taking, and branding in one elegant product,  is the perfect solution. It enhances productivity, supports sustainability, and elevates brand presence—making it a smart investment for businesses and professionals alike.
